literal_hit_reporting: count of files with a literal match; the files are not named, so a literal can never leak through this report
patterns: sk-... (letters, digits, hyphen, underscore; covers sk-ant-, sk-proj-), JWT eyJ..., Bearer ... (16+ chars)
process_rule: cwd under the campaign directory, or command line matching provider-(campaign|claude-account|acp)-worker|antigravity_campaign_worker or c8-live-W0vn
does_not_cover: secrets of 20 to 39 characters in a credential file are not searched as literals (floor of 40, accepted because shorter values there are identifiers and public metadata); patterns inside the control state; transcripts the client persists under its own home; truncated or re-encoded values; the raw process listing is not versioned
